overview: burningShip is taught from its pinned FRM-like/1 definition. Follow the absolute-value temporary a and the power-dependent reconstruction of z as source operations, rather than treating an image as guaranteed. The pinned mechanical profile supplies one concrete viewing setup, not a universal visual prediction.
mathSummary: The loop sets a = abs(z). When power == 2 it assigns real(z) = real(a) * real(a) - imag(a) * imag(a), imag(z) = 2 * real(a) * imag(a), and then z = z + c; otherwise it assigns z = a ^ power + c.
